name: phase0b
description: Phase 0b broader feasibility: four fixed behind-baseline doubles recordings, staged sample windows, player tracking and a first ball-tracking baseline. Windows marked 'tune' are the ones configuration was looked at on; 'test' windows and the whole pro63 clip are held out.

gold.video: data/raw/Gold Medal Match Pickleball Senior Mixed Doubles 3.5 60-65 Gold Medal Match Fall Brawl.mp4
gold.description: Senior mixed doubles 3.5, 60-65 gold medal match. Outdoor, sunny, adjacent courts and bleachers in view. 78.6 min, the long recording. Camera low and centred behind the near baseline; the near-left baseline corner is outside the frame.
gold.quality: good light, low camera, far half strongly foreshortened

segments.notes: No camera jump above 6 px between 5 s samples over the whole recording.

buzz.video: data/raw/The Better Buzz San Diego Open - 5.0 Men's Doubles - Pinoy Pickleball International (1080p).mp4
buzz.description: 5.0 men's doubles, outdoor tournament, 14.7 min. Camera centred and elevated behind the near baseline; whole court including both near corners visible.

segments.notes: The camera is still being placed for the first ~8 s; everything after is stationary.

riggs.video: data/raw/Unedited Pickleball Match Men's Doubles Game 5 Rec Play 2025-7-5 - Riggs Pickleball (1080p).mp4
riggs.description: Men's doubles rec play, indoor, 15.4 min. Wide-angle camera behind the near baseline but offset to the right and rolled. The camera is moved once, at 6:08.

segments.notes: First camera position; moved by ~104 px at 368 s.
Second camera position, stable until a final move at 920 s.

pro63.video: data/raw/Pickleball Pro Men's Doubles WITH Commentary from a 6.3 DUPR - Kevin Dong Pickleball (1080p).mp4
pro63.description: 6.3 DUPR men's doubles with commentary, indoor, 21 min. Held-out hard condition: fast play, softer image, burned-in scoreboard, spectators along the bottom edge. Camera elevated and offset behind the near baseline; the far baseline is hidden behind the net tape.

segments.notes: Stationary throughout: median drift 0.5 px against the first frame.

windows.purpose: Early play, team A on the near side. Primary tuning window for the long recording.
Straddles the game break at 820-950 s: the teams change ends and play resumes with team B near. Tests end-switch handling.
Middle of the match, held out from tuning.
Late in the 78 min recording, lower sun and long shadows. Held out.
Best-quality centred camera; primary tuning window and first ball-tracking window.
Later in the same match, held out from tuning.
Laterally offset, rolled wide-angle camera (first position).
Second camera position of the same match: tests that a moved camera needs, and gets, its own calibration.
Held-out hard condition: 6.3 DUPR play, softer image, spectators along the bottom edge.
